name: office-memory
description: Manual V1 Lite method for AI-curated daily, current, and durable project memory.

interface.shortDescription: Manual daily, awareness, and durable project memory.
interface.longDescription: Office Memory V1 Lite manually curates meaningful YYYY-MM-DD.md project records, current AWARENESS.md, and durable MEMORY.md from explicitly selected read-only sources and project materials.
defaultPrompt: Use $office-memory:manage-office-memory to curate today's meaningful project memory.
Use $office-memory:manage-office-memory to initialize reviewed AWARENESS.md and MEMORY.md.
Use $office-memory:manage-office-memory with explicit project materials for a focused awareness update.
